documented_behavior: Oracle documents java.lang.NullPointerException as thrown when null is used where an object is required, including calling an instance method of null or accessing a null object's field.
This documented behavior concerns java.lang.NullPointerException, not an established type named java.lang.NullPointer.
preconditions: For an actual JVM-level NullPointerException, execution must reach an operation requiring a non-null object, array, or Throwable value with a null operand.
The supplied field/value names require project-specific source and runtime evidence before they can be mapped to such an operation.
